integrity: Exact formulas follow from analytic coefficient and Jacobi spectral arguments. Finite computational checks corroborate but do not certify the infinite spectrum.
scientific_limitations: The exact constants concern equal-mass m-th-root measures, the canonical H(b) kernel norm, and the specific b=(1+z^m)/2. They are not asserted for arbitrary atomic measures or symbols. Publication-priority verification beyond the identified sources is incomplete.
title: Sharp norm-equivalence constants for root-of-unity Dirichlet and de Branges–Rovnyak spaces
